title: Against those who say the soul is breath
pass_a_gloss: Against those who say the soul is pneuma (breath) or air. Breath and air are bodies; what is bodily is dimensional and moved from without or within. If soul were breath, the living would live only as long as air is moved in them. But the soul is not identical with the air that comes and goes. Therefore the soul is not pneuma.
pass_b_english: Others call the soul breath or air. Air is a body — spread out and shoved about. If soul were only that rush of air, life would last only while breathing lasts. The soul is not the air that enters and leaves. So the soul is not pneuma.
